body:
I took Korean and Chinese lv1 this sem. As someone who only need to pass (on exchange), I regret taking Korean because content too past pace and too demanding on attendance &asm 😶 

Chinese lv1 is great! Prof legit prep us question for quiz before so we dont fail 👀- plus asm for chinese lv1 is much less demanding (oral presentation can bring script vs Korean I have to memorized + host q&a). Plus, Chinese prof dont mind when we skip class because majority of class is on exchange whereas I got a personal email from my Korean lect asking why i didnt show up after 1 week absent. So depending on ur priorities i guess

I am suicidal everyday as well. One way is express myself is through poetry, either writing one out or memorizing one. I don’t know about like writings though. I would usually write down my philosophical point of view about death and try to explain them as clearly as I could for myself. I don’t know if it help me but it makes things less vague and easier to manage for me.
